info.title: Pipeline CRM Universal API
info.description: Manage Pipeline CRM deals, people, companies, tasks, and activities

post.description: Creates a new activity note in Pipeline CRM.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

note.userId.description: The owner user ID of the note.

note.dealId.description: The deal ID associated with the note.

note.companyId.description: The company ID associated with the note.

post.description: Creates a new calendar task or event in Pipeline CRM.

calendarEntry.allDay.description: Whether the event is all day.

post.description: Creates a new deal in Pipeline CRM.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

deliverAssignmentEmail.description: Send an assignment email when the deal is assigned to another user.

deal.summary.description: Explanatory or descriptive text about the deal.

deal.userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this deal.

deal.status.description: The deal status ID for this deal.

deal.expectedCloseDate.description: The date the deal is expected to close by (YYYY-MM-DD).

deal.value.description: The deal's value in its currency.

deal.primaryContactId.description: The primary contact person ID associated with this deal.

deal.personIds[].description: Person record IDs associated with this deal.

deal.companyId.description: The company ID associated with this deal.

deal.companyName.description: Creates or associates a company with this deal by name.

deal.probability.description: Probability from 0-100 that the deal will close.

deal.dealStageId.description: The deal stage ID for this deal.

deal.dealLossReasonId.description: The deal loss reason ID for this deal.

deal.dealWonReasonId.description: The deal won reason ID for this deal.

deal.dealSource.description: The lead source ID for this deal.

deal.tagIds[].description: Tag IDs to set on this deal.

todoTemplateId.description: The todo template ID to apply to this deal.

todoTemplateUserId.description: The owner of tasks created from the todo template.
